title: Migrate from MinIO
lead: Three steps: print the object-copy command, print the IAM command, then open a local evidence file. Source credentials stay in your shell. This page does not send or store them.
commandHint: Keys are the environment variables below. Nothing on this form is saved on the server.
bucketsHint: Comma-separated. Empty copies every bucket the source key can list.
evidenceHint: Choose the evidence.json written by the command. It is read in the browser only.
evidenceBad: That file is not a migration evidence document.
iamHint: Imports MinIO users, groups, and policies. MinIO secrets are not copied. New keys are written to a file on the machine that runs the command. LDAP and OIDC users are listed as warnings. This page does not send credentials.
keepKeys: Use access keys from $KEEP_ACCESS_KEYS_FILE instead of generating them
